Cowork 上手實戰The Cowork Playbook

跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.

不只是會聊天的 AI，是會動手幫你把事做完的代理式 Copilot。Not an AI that just chats — the agentic Copilot that gets the work done.

5 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到對外溝通，帶你看 Cowork 如何自己規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。5 real business scenarios — from reading files and writing documents to crunching data and communicating outbound. Watch Cowork plan, execute, and pause for your approval before every outbound action. Then make it your own.

✅使用前準備與限制Prerequisites & limits

  • 已知限制Known limits不能存取本機檔案、不能刪除 OneDrive/SharePoint 檔案、不能讀加密檔；自訂技能未驗證，請審閱輸出；僅 Anthropic 支援區域。Cannot access local files, delete OneDrive/SharePoint files, or read encrypted files; custom skills are unvalidated, so review outputs; Anthropic-supported regions only.
🧭怎麼使用這本手冊How to use it
  1. 下載範例檔Download the sample 每個情境都附現成素材，下載後上傳給 Cowork。Each scenario ships ready-made material to upload to Cowork.
  2. 照著提示詞做Follow the prompts 複製步驟裡的提示詞，對照實機截圖一步步操作。Copy each prompt and match the real screenshots.
  3. 換成你的情境Make it yours 用「延伸你的工作」把同一套流程套到你的日常。Use "Extend to your work" to apply it to your day-to-day.
  4. 結果不會每次一樣Results vary each run Cowork 是 AI 產出，同一個提示詞每次的用字、判讀深度、甚至自我檢查抓到的問題都可能不同。截圖是「某一次」的實際結果，不是標準答案 —— 請照「產出驗收」逐項核對，而不是比對畫面是否一模一樣。Cowork is AI-generated: the same prompt can differ each run in wording, depth of interpretation, and even which issues its self-check catches. Screenshots show one actual run, not an expected answer — verify against the "Acceptance checklist" rather than expecting an identical screen.

收件匣晨間助理Inbox Morning Assistant

⏱ 約 6 分鐘 · 難度 ★☆☆⏱ ~6 min · Level ★☆☆

把一份『分流規則』交給 Cowork，讓它每天早上用同一套標準幫你掃過收件匣、分四象限、挑出今天非回不可的信，再產出一份 5 分鐘讀完的晨間簡報 —— 把雜亂的開機第一小時，變成一份清晰的行動清單。Hand Cowork a single triage ruleset and let it sweep your inbox every morning by the same standard, sort mail into four quadrants, surface the must-reply emails, and produce a 5-minute morning brief — turning a chaotic first hour into a clear action list.

會用到的技能Skills usedOutlook

🎯情境背景Scenario

你每天一開機就被幾十封信淹沒：客戶提問、同事追進度、系統通知、電子報全混在一起，光是判斷『哪封要先回』就耗掉專注力。與其每天自己重判一次，不如把你的判斷標準寫成一份規則，交給 Cowork 每天早上照同一套邏輯幫你分流、排序、寫成晨間簡報。Every morning you're buried in dozens of emails — client questions, colleagues chasing progress, system notifications and newsletters all mixed together — and just deciding what to reply first drains your focus. Instead of re-judging it yourself daily, write your judgment down as a ruleset and let Cowork triage, prioritize and brief you by the same logic every morning.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎S1_收件匣分流與每日簡報規則.mdS1_Inbox_Triage_and_Daily_Brief_Rules.md四象限分流規則、緊急度標記、一週規劃原則、每日晨間簡報格式Four-quadrant triage rules, urgency flagging, weekly planning principles, and the daily morning-brief format

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

上傳規則並請它分流今天的收件匣Upload the rules & ask it to triage today's inbox

把分流規則 md 上傳，請 Cowork 讀取你的收件匣、套用這套規則做分類，並依規則產出今天的晨間簡報。重點是：你只需把『判斷標準』寫清楚一次，之後每天都用同一句觸發語就能重跑。Upload the triage rules md and ask Cowork to read your inbox, classify it by these rules, and produce today's morning brief. The point: you write the criteria down clearly once, then re-run it every day with the same phrase.

提示詞Prompt
附件是我的『收件匣分流與每日簡報規則』。請讀取我的收件匣，套用這份規則把今天的信分成四象限，從『需我親自回覆』中挑出最多 3 封最優先，並依規則格式產出一份『今日晨間簡報』，讓我 5 分鐘就能掌握今天該做什麼。Attached are my "inbox triage and daily brief rules". Please read my inbox, apply these rules to sort today's mail into the four quadrants, pick at most 3 top-priority emails from "needs my reply", and produce a "today's morning brief" in the rule's format so I can grasp what to do today in 5 minutes.
2

觀察它如何讀信、逐封套規則Watch it read mail & apply rules per message

Cowork 會載入 Outlook 技能、實際讀取你的收件匣，再逐封比對你的規則做分類 —— 你能在『思考流程』看到它怎麼判斷每封信屬於哪一象限、為什麼某幾封被標為最優先。這是『把你的標準交給它執行』，而不是它自己亂猜。Cowork loads the Outlook skill, actually reads your inbox, then matches each message against your rules — in the "thinking" trace you can see how it decides which quadrant each email belongs to and why a few are flagged top priority. It executes your standard rather than guessing its own.

3

收到你的每日晨間簡報Receive your daily morning brief

成果是一份按你規則格式排好的晨間簡報：今日焦點、今日會議、必須回覆的 ⭐ 清單（含對象與一句話重點）、等待中、提醒。一眼就能決定今天先做什麼 —— 而且明天只要再說一次『幫我整理收件匣』就能重來。The result is a morning brief laid out in your rule's format: today's focus, today's meetings, the ⭐ must-reply list (with who and a one-line point), what you're waiting on, and reminders. You can decide what to do first at a glance — and tomorrow it re-runs from just "sort my inbox".

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

這個情境是『唯讀』的 —— Cowork 只讀信、不替你回覆或寄出，所以不會跳行動審核卡，你可以放心每天讓它跑。它的價值在於『一致性』：同一套標準天天執行，不會因為你今天累了就漏看。若你進一步請它『幫每封最優先的信草擬回覆』，那屬於對外動作，就會回到核准後才送出的流程。This scenario is read-only — Cowork only reads mail, it doesn't reply or send for you, so no action-approval card appears and you can safely run it daily. Its value is consistency: the same standard applied every day, never skipped because you're tired. If you go further and ask it to draft replies to each top email, that becomes an outbound action and returns to the approve-before-send flow.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • Cowork 讀取了你的真實收件匣並套用上傳的規則Cowork read your actual inbox and applied the uploaded rules
  • 今天的信被分成四象限（需我回覆／需追蹤／可授權／僅供參考）Today's mail is sorted into four quadrants (reply / track / delegate / FYI)
  • 最多 3 封最優先信被標為 ⭐，且附帶判斷理由At most 3 top-priority emails are flagged ⭐ with the reasoning
  • 產出一份依規則格式排好的『今日晨間簡報』Produces a "today's morning brief" laid out in the rule's format

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把規則改成你自己的判斷標準（你的 VIP 名單、你的象限定義），打造專屬分流邏輯。Adapt the rules to your own criteria (your VIP list, your quadrant definitions) for a personal triage logic.
  • 把這套流程存成自訂技能（見情境 5），之後只要一句觸發語就跑完整套晨間流程。Save this flow as a custom skill (see Scenario 5) so one trigger phrase runs the whole morning routine.
  • 再請它為每封最優先信草擬回覆，核准後一次寄出 —— 把『讀』延伸成『行動』。Then have it draft replies for each top email and send after approval — extending "read" into "act".

客戶拜訪 360Customer Visit 360

⏱ 約 10 分鐘 · 難度 ★☆☆⏱ ~10 min · Level ★☆☆

從一份客戶背景資料出發，讓 Cowork 自動產出「會前簡報重點」，會議後再請它草擬「跟進信」並在你核准後寄出 —— 完整體驗代理式工作流。Start from a single client background file: let Cowork auto-generate a pre-meeting brief, then draft a follow-up email after the meeting and send it only after your approval — a full agentic workflow.

會用到的技能Skills usedWordOutlook

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是一位企業解決方案的業務，明天要拜訪一家智慧製造客戶。你手上只有一份整理過的「客戶背景資料」，但要在會前快速消化重點、預想客戶疑慮，會後又得及時寄出專業的跟進信。這些重複又吃時間的前置與收尾，正適合交給 Cowork。You are an enterprise solutions seller visiting a smart-manufacturing client tomorrow. You only have one prepared client background file, yet you must digest the key points before the meeting, anticipate the client's concerns, and promptly send a polished follow-up afterward. These repetitive, time-consuming bookends are perfect to hand off to Cowork.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎S2_客戶拜訪背景_鴻運智慧科技.docxS2_Client_Background_Hongyun_Smart_Tech.docx客戶背景資料（公司概況、關鍵聯絡人、互動紀錄、拜訪目標、已知風險）Client background (company profile, key contacts, interaction history, visit goals, known risks)

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

上傳背景檔並下指令Upload the background file & give the instruction

在 Cowork 首頁點「新增附件 → 上傳影像和檔案」，選擇背景資料 docx，再輸入你的請求：請它根據附件產生一份會前簡報重點，明確列出你要的段落。On the Cowork home, click "Add attachment → Upload images and files", pick the background docx, then type your request: ask it to produce a pre-meeting brief from the attachment, spelling out the sections you want.

提示詞Prompt
我明天要拜訪附件中的這家客戶。請根據這份背景資料，幫我準備一份「會前簡報重點」，內容包含：客戶現況摘要、本次拜訪三個關鍵目標、預期客戶會提出的疑慮與建議回應、以及我方應主動帶出的兩個價值主張。整理成一份條理清楚的 Word 文件。I'm visiting the client in the attachment tomorrow. Based on this background file, please prepare a "pre-meeting brief" containing: a summary of the client's current situation, three key goals for this visit, the concerns the client is likely to raise with suggested responses, and the two value propositions we should proactively bring up. Organize it into a clear, well-structured Word document.
2

觀察代理式工作流與產出Watch the agentic workflow & output

送出後，Cowork 會自動讀取附件（載入 Word 技能）、思考、產生文件並自我驗證。右側「工作區」面板會同時顯示『參考』(你的輸入檔)、『輸出』(產生的 Word) 與『技能』。注意：它甚至會主動指出你說的『明天』與文件日期不一致，請你確認。After sending, Cowork automatically reads the attachment (loads the Word skill), reasons, generates the document and self-validates. The right-side "Workspace" panel shows References (your input), Output (the generated Word) and Skills at once. Note: it even flags that your "tomorrow" doesn't match the date in the file, asking you to confirm.

3

會後：草擬跟進信並核准寄出After: draft the follow-up & approve to send

會議結束後，請 Cowork 寫一封跟進信給客戶聯絡人。寄信這類『對外動作』會觸發Cowork 的『行動前審核』——它把整封信攤開成可編輯的預覽（收件者、主旨、本文），你檢查或修改後再按『傳送』，主導權始終在你手上。After the meeting, ask Cowork to write a follow-up email to the client contact. Outbound actions like sending email trigger Cowork's "approval before action" — it lays out the full editable preview (recipient, subject, body); you review or edit, then hit "Send". You stay in control the whole time.

提示詞Prompt
請幫我草擬一封給林志明的客戶拜訪後跟進郵件，主旨「拜訪後跟進與下一步」，感謝撥冗會面、條列三個討論重點、提出兩個下一步行動與時程，語氣專業友善。寫好後寄出。Please draft a post-visit follow-up email to Lin Zhi-ming, subject "Follow-up and next steps after our visit": thank them for their time, list the three discussion highlights, propose two next-step actions with timing, in a professional and friendly tone. Send it once it's ready.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

寄信、發 Teams、建立會議等『會影響他人或對外』的動作，Cowork 一律先停下來等你核准。審核卡上你可以直接改收件者、主旨與內容，確認無誤再送出 —— 這是 Cowork 與一般聊天最大的不同。Any action that affects others or goes outbound — sending email, posting to Teams, creating meetings — pauses for your approval. On the approval card you can edit the recipient, subject and body directly, then send once you're satisfied. This is the biggest difference from ordinary chat.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 會前簡報 Word 檔已產生，含四個段落且內容對應背景資料Pre-meeting brief Word file generated with four sections matching the background
  • 跟進信在你核准後才寄出，收件者與主旨正確Follow-up email sent only after your approval, with correct recipient & subject
  • 產出檔案已存到 OneDrive 的 Cowork 資料夾Output files saved to the Cowork folder in OneDrive

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把背景檔換成你真實的客戶資料（去識別化後），讓 Cowork 產生你下一場拜訪的 brief。Swap in your real (de-identified) client data and let Cowork build the brief for your next visit.
  • 請 Cowork 把會前簡報直接做成 PowerPoint，而不是 Word。Ask Cowork to produce the brief as PowerPoint instead of Word.
  • 會後用手機語音口述會議重點，讓 Cowork 整理成跟進信 —— 零鍵盤完成收尾。Dictate meeting notes by phone after the visit and let Cowork turn them into a follow-up email — wrap up with zero typing.

數據 / 營運Data / Operations

數據變洞察From Data to Insight

⏱ 約 8 分鐘 · 難度 ★☆☆⏱ ~8 min · Level ★☆☆

丟一份原始銷售明細給 Cowork，讓它自動算出樞紐彙總、用公式連動、標出最佳與最差，並寫出關鍵發現 —— 把一張流水帳變成一份能直接彙報的分析儀表板。Hand Cowork a raw sales ledger and let it auto-compute pivot summaries, wire up live formulas, flag best and worst performers, and write the key findings — turning a flat list into a board-ready analysis dashboard.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcel

🎯情境背景Scenario

你手上有一份 2026 下半年的銷售原始明細（產品線、區域、業務員、銷售額、訂單、退貨），主管想看的是『哪條產品線最強、哪一區最弱、退貨集中在哪、誰是 Top 業務』這種洞察，而不是一張看不出重點的流水帳。這種彙總分析正是 Cowork 的強項。You have a raw H2-2026 sales ledger (product line, region, salesperson, sales, orders, returns). Your manager wants insight — which line is strongest, which region lags, where returns concentrate, who's the top rep — not a flat list with no signal. This kind of summarization is exactly where Cowork shines.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎S3_銷售原始數據_2026下半年.xlsxS3_Sales_Raw_Data_H2_2026.xlsx20 筆 2026 下半年銷售原始明細（月份／產品線／區域／業務員／銷售額／訂單數／退貨數）20 raw H2-2026 sales rows (month / product line / region / salesperson / sales / orders / returns)

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

上傳數據並說清楚你要的分析Upload the data & spell out the analysis

把原始 xlsx 上傳，並把你要的分析講具體：要哪些維度的小計與佔比、要不要退貨率、要不要標出最佳/最差、要不要文字洞察、數字格式怎麼要求。越具體，產出越貼近你要的。Upload the raw xlsx and be specific about the analysis: which dimensions to subtotal and show as a share, whether to add return rate, whether to flag best/worst, whether to write text insights, and the number formatting. The more specific you are, the closer the output.

提示詞Prompt
附件是我們 2026 下半年的銷售原始數據。請幫我做一份「銷售分析儀表板」Excel：1) 新增彙總工作表，用樞紐方式算出各產品線、各區域、各業務員的銷售額小計與佔比，以及整體退貨率；2) 標出表現最好與最差的產品線/區域，並用一段文字摘要三個關鍵發現與建議；3) 數字格式化（千分位、百分比）。完成後存成新的 Excel 檔。The attachment is our raw H2-2026 sales data. Please build a "sales analysis dashboard" Excel for me: 1) add a summary sheet that pivots out the sales subtotals and share for each product line, region and salesperson, plus the overall return rate; 2) flag the best- and worst-performing product lines/regions, and write a short paragraph summarizing three key findings and recommendations; 3) format the numbers (thousands separators, percentages). Save it as a new Excel file when done.
2

觀察它如何自我驗證數字Watch it self-verify the numbers

Cowork 不是直接套公式就交差 —— 它會先用 Python 把彙總數字算出來『對答案』（範例中先驗出整體退貨率 5.79%、雲端ERP 最強、IIoT 最弱），再建立 Excel、檢查公式錯誤、重算，最後確認各表小計加總都對回總額 NT$38,210,000 才交付。Cowork doesn't just drop in formulas and call it done — it first computes the aggregates in Python to "check the answer" (the example verifies an overall return rate of 5.79%, Cloud ERP strongest, IIoT weakest), then builds the Excel, checks for formula errors, recalculates, and only ships after every subtotal reconciles back to the NT$38,210,000 total.

3

打開儀表板驗收成果Open the dashboard to verify

點開產出的 xlsx 預覽：頂部是 KPI 區（總銷售額／訂單／退貨／整體退貨率），下面三張樞紐彙總表（產品線／區域／業務員）各含小計、佔比、退貨率，並以綠底★標最佳、紅底▼標最差；最底下是『關鍵發現與建議』。所有數字都用 SUMIF 公式連動原始數據表，你改一筆數字整張表就重算。Open the generated xlsx preview: a KPI strip on top (total sales / orders / returns / overall return rate), then three pivot tables (product line / region / salesperson) each with subtotals, share and return rate, best marked ★ on green and worst ▼ on red; the key findings sit at the bottom. Every number is wired to the raw-data sheet via SUMIF, so editing one row recalculates the whole sheet.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

數據分析最怕『算錯卻看不出來』。Cowork 的可信之處在於它會自己交叉驗算（Python 對答案、公式零錯誤、小計對回總額），並把推理過程攤在『思考流程』裡讓你檢視 —— 但正式彙報前，仍建議你抽查一兩個關鍵數字，把 AI 當成『做好初稿的分析師』而非最終簽核。The danger in data analysis is being wrong without noticing. Cowork earns trust by cross-checking itself (Python verification, zero formula errors, subtotals reconciling to the total) and exposing its reasoning in the "thinking" trace — but before you report it up, still spot-check a key figure or two and treat the AI as an analyst who drafted it well, not the final sign-off.

  • 數字已格式化（千分位、百分比），且以 SUMIF 公式連動可重算Numbers are formatted (thousands, percentages) and wired with SUMIF formulas for live recalculation

這個情境最能看出 Cowork 的『可信』邊界：它會自己上網查、附上來源讓你能查證；查不到的內部數據它誠實留白而非杜撰；做完還自我視覺驗證。本次只產出檔案、沒有對外動作，所以不跳審核卡；但若你延伸到『把簡報發布到 Teams 或寄給客戶』，那就是對外動作，會回到核准後才送出的流程。把 AI 當成『做好初稿的分析師』，正式對客戶前你仍要補上真實內部數字並過目。This scenario best reveals Cowork's trust boundary: it researches online and attaches sources you can verify; it honestly leaves internal data it can't find blank rather than fabricating; and it self-verifies visually when done. 先問 Cowork：技能怎麼建？Ask Cowork: how do skills work?
